items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Irving Ashby, and a disk jockey from Alaska named Jerome...I can't remember Jerome's last name...Those were the Four Brothers.

ctx.x: Well, the ones at Normandie Hall didn't really make any money, I don't think. Because Jimmy used to come by... Jimmy, who is now attorney James Talbert, and who was also the nephew of Lee and Lester Young. But at that point he was like a law student and a Jazz fan. He played a little himself. But Jimmy, Irving Ashby, and a disk jockey from Alaska named Jerome...I can't remember Jerome's last name...and a writer named Joe Bernard. Those were the Four Brothers. And they were The Four Brothers Present at Normandie…
That's funny. Unemployment checks were about $18 a week.
